newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's UDI bonds real return 6.87 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's UDI bonds real return 6.87 pct.

text.p: Mexico's 1,092-day UDI bonds were assigned at a price of 97.65989 UDIs and a real return of 6.87 percent at the primary auction on Tuesday.
Two weeks ago the 1,064-day UDI bonds had a real return of 6.49 percent.
Demand this week, however, did not cover the amount of the 1,092 day UDIs on offer. Demand was just 478.12 million UDIs compared to 500 million UDIs on offer from Banco de Mexico.
The 1,778-day UDIs were assigned at a price of 96.72283 UDIs and a real return of 6.79 percent.
Two weeks ago the 1,792-day UDI bonds had a real return of 6.47 percent.
Demand this week was 264.69 million UDIs compared to 250 million UDIs on offer from Banco de Mexico with a bid-to-cover ratio of 1.06.
